title: Custom Christian Faith Semi Truck in Front of Large Comforter
description:
Drive like a boss and live like a legend with the Jeminise Custom Trucker Comforter Set. Specially designed for truckers, this modern bedding set features the soulful Trucker's Prayer design, showcasing a semi truck, wooden cross, and beautiful decorative scrolls. Perfect as a meaningful gift for family, friends, or yourself, it brings comfort, faith, and inspiration to any bedroom setting.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features a customizable text input so you can personalize your trucker bedding with a name or unique message.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with a whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping and shifting.
  • Vibrant & Eco-Friendly: Advanced digital printing ensures colors hold dye and resist fading with no harmful chemicals used.
  • Versatile Comforter Set: Durable, lightweight, and breathable material that feels like soft cotton and can also be used as a cozy blanket.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, air dry without heat or tumble dry on low heat for quick, fluffy results.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type 100% Brushed Polyester
Fill Material Microfiber
Selected Design Trucker's Prayer
Pattern Trucker Stuff Tapestry
Theme Trucker / Christian Faith
Available Sizes Twin, Full, Queen, King
Care Instructions Machine Wash Cold, Tumble Dry Low, Do Not Bleach
